description: This file defines error pattern matching functions and constants related to error message classification, including rate limits, server errors, timeout errors, billing errors, and authentication errors.

methods.name: matchesErrorPatterns
methods.description: Checks if a raw error message matches any pattern in a list of ErrorPattern.

methods.name: matchesErrorPatternGroups
methods.description: Checks if a raw error message matches any pattern in any of the provided pattern groups.
